entities.name: Measurement reporting
entities.description: Procedure where the UE reports measurement results to the network based on configured measurement configurations and triggering conditions.

entities.name: MeasurementReport
entities.description: RRC message used by the UE to send measurement results to the network.

entities.name: measResults
entities.description: Information element containing the actual measurement results reported by the UE.

entities.name: Measurement trigger condition
entities.description: Condition that triggers the UE to send a measurement report, based on configured measurement events and thresholds.

relations.description: The measurement reporting procedure includes sending the MeasurementReport message.
The MeasurementReport message contains the measResults information element.
The measurement reporting procedure is triggered when measurement trigger conditions are met.
